# Documentation

Everything here is generated from one source: the console's doc folder in this repository, [`AgentVault/agentvault_registry/src/agentvault_registry/static/new_registry_frontend/src/assets/docs`](../AgentVault/agentvault_registry/src/agentvault_registry/static/new_registry_frontend/src/assets/docs). Every console renders the same pages (`#/docs` and `#/operator-docs`), and [docs.theprotocol.cloud](https://docs.theprotocol.cloud) publishes them. To change a page, edit its source there; the export refuses a copy here that differs from it.
